f(x)=w^T + b
and if f(x) < 0 --> class -1 is choosen for that dataset
and if f(x) > 0 --> class +1 is choosen for that dataset

and the target class is encoded as -1 and +1 
if number of classes 
w1x1 + w2x2 + w3x3 + b=0
it tries to find margin betweeen line and support vector and tries to find maximum margin and iteratively improves.
